title: Bloom Algo
tagline: Making algo trading feel less like an algorithm.
summary: Plug-and-play algo trading. Choose a strategy, deploy in two clicks.
disciplines: Product Strategy · Product Design · Visual Direction · Fintech
team: With the Bloom Algo product and engineering team
scope: Product direction, interaction model, visual language, design system

sections.heading: Algo trading promises speed and discipline.
body: But for many retail traders, getting started still means dealing with coding, configuration, backtesting and broker APIs.
Bloom started with a simpler question:
sections.statement: What if using an algo felt as easy as using an app?

sections.heading: Choose. Deploy. Trade.
body: Bloom is a plug-and-play platform built around pre-configured trading strategies.
Connect a broker, choose a strategy, and deploy without configuring entry, exit or risk parameters.
sections.statement: Two clicks from strategy to live deployment.

sections.heading: A marketplace, not a builder
body: Instead of asking traders to build strategies, Bloom presents a curated marketplace of ready-to-use systems with clear strategy, market and performance context.

sections.heading: Automation without the black box
body: Removing complexity shouldn't mean removing visibility.
Bloom keeps traders connected through live P&L, positions, execution status and WhatsApp alerts.

sections.heading: Designed around confidence
body: Trading products often communicate through dense charts and high-intensity interfaces.
Clear hierarchy, approachable surfaces and a softer visual language make the product easier to enter without making it feel lightweight.

sections.heading: One continuous experience
body: From broker connection to strategy selection, deployment, monitoring and risk events, every touchpoint belongs to the same system.

sections.heading: Designing the system
body: My work spanned the product experience, interaction model, visual direction and the system connecting them.
The focus was on reducing unnecessary configuration, making strategy selection clearer, and keeping risk and performance visible throughout the experience.
sections.statement: The complexity still exists. It just doesn't need to sit in front of the user.

result.heading: The result
body: Bloom turns algorithmic trading from something users have to build into something they can simply choose and deploy.
